examples.question: What did each region bring in?
examples.gold: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC
examples.predicted: SELECT region_name FROM regions GROUP BY region_name

examples.question: Name the region with the largest sales total
examples.gold: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1
examples.predicted: SELECT region_name FROM regions GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

examples.question: Top region for November 2025
examples.gold: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1
examples.predicted: SELECT t1.region_name FROM regions AS t1 JOIN orders AS t2 ON t1.region_id = t2.region_id WHERE t2.name = 'November 2025'
